items.title: 14.6 S.H.M. ki graph ke zariye numaindagi (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.6 with Fig. 14.9 (PDF 31).

blocks.text: S.H.M karne wale jism ke displacement, velocity aur acceleration ko waqt ke saath graph par Fig. 14.9 (a, b aur c) mein dikhaya gaya hai.
(i) S.H.M karne wale zarre ka displacement:
Is se pata chalta hai ke extreme position par zarre ka displacement sab se zyada (x₀) hota hai.

blocks.alt: Aik period mein displacement aur waqt ka graph, har chauthai period aur xo, -xo par dashed lakeerein. Curve +xo se shuru, sifar se guzar kar -xo tak aur wapas +xo tak.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.9 (a): S.H.M karte jism ke displacement ki graph ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 14.9 (a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: (ii) S.H.M karne wale zarre ki velocity ki miqdar (magnitude):

Simt (direction) ke saath velocity v = −x₀ω sin(ωt) hai, kyun ke +x₀ se chhora gaya jism pehle O ki taraf, yani manfi (negative) simt mein chalta hai. Velocity mean position par sab se zyada (v = x₀ω) aur extreme positions par zero hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Aik period mein velocity ka graph, xo omega aur -xo omega ke darmiyan. Curve sifar se shuru, chauthai period par -xo omega, aadhe par sifar, teen chauthai par +xo omega aur phir sifar.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.9 (b): S.H.M karte jism ki velocity ki graph ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 14.9 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ka velocity graph zero se pehle oopar jata hai, yani v = +x₀ω sin(ωt). Lekin jab jism +x₀ se chhora jaye to woh O ki taraf, yani manfi simt mein chalta hai, is liye sahi velocity v = −x₀ω sin(ωt) hai aur graph zero se pehle neeche jata hai; khaaka yahi dikhata hai. Teenon graph milayein: jahan displacement sab se zyada hai wahan velocity zero hai, aur acceleration hamesha displacement ke ulat hai.
(iii) S.H.M karne wale zarre ka acceleration:
Is mein x = x₀ cos ωt rakhein:
Acceleration extreme positions par sab se zyada (x₀ω²) aur mean position par zero hota hai.

blocks.alt: Aik period mein acceleration ka graph, omega square xo aur minus omega square xo ke darmiyan. Curve sab se manfi qeemat se shuru, aadhe period par zyada se zyada, phir wapas: hamesha displacement ke ulat.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.9 (c): S.H.M karte jism ke acceleration ki graph ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 14.9 (c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Equations (14.19), (14.20) aur (14.21) ke graphs (Fig. 14.9 a, b, c) se yeh nateeja nikalta hai:

items: Velocity aur displacement ka phase difference π/2 (chauthai chakkar) hai.
Acceleration aur displacement ka phase difference π (aadha chakkar) hai: jab displacement +x₀ par sab se zyada hai to acceleration sab se zyada manfi hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke acceleration aur displacement ka phase difference π/2 hai. a = −ω²x se saaf hai ke acceleration hamesha displacement ke bilkul ulat hai, is liye un ka phase difference π hai. Velocity in dono se π/2 alag hai. Kitab ka aakhri jumla ('displacement, velocity aur acceleration ka phase difference π/2 hai') bhi isi tarah samjhein: har agli quantity pichhli se π/2 aage hai (x se v, v se a).

blocks.prompt: S.H.M mein kis jagah (a) speed aur (b) acceleration sab se zyada hota hai?
blocks.explanation: (a) Speed mean position par sab se zyada, x₀ω, aur extreme par zero. (b) Acceleration extreme positions par sab se zyada, x₀ω², aur mean position par zero.

items: x = x₀cosωt; v = −x₀ω sinωt (miqdar x₀ω sinωt); a = −x₀ω² cosωt.
v aur x mein π/2 ka farq; a aur x mein π ka farq (bilkul ulat).
